blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deepfake detectors are commonly evaluated on real/fake classification alone, but real-world applications require explanations of the visual evidence behind each prediction. Joint vision-language models struggle with authenticity assessment, producing "real" narratives for manipulated images. To address this, we propose a decoupled predict-then-explain pipeline as our submission to the ACM Multimedia 2026 Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge, with methods trained and evaluated on the XPlainVerse benchmark. A vision-foundation-model ensemble first classifies the image, then a Qwen3-VL-8B model generates a decision-conditioned explanation of the visual evidence. For fake images, a second Qwen3-VL-8B compresses that text into a short non-expert summary without using the image. We further apply metric-aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to optimize both explainers against the challenge criteria. Under matched conditions, GRPO raises complex BERTScore-F1 from 0.686 to 0.712 and also improves grounding (entity and evidence F1); our submission ranked first on complex BERTScore-F1 and seventh overall.
blocks.zh: 深假探测器通常单靠真实/假分类来评价,但现实世界的应用需要解释每个预测背后的视觉证据. 联合视觉语言模型与真实性评估相抗争,为被操纵的图像出出"真实"的叙述. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议在提交ACM多媒体2026号解释性深假探测挑战报告时,采用一个脱钩的预测和解释性管道,对XPlainVerse基准的方法进行培训和评价。 一个视觉创始-模型组合首先对图像进行分类,再由Quen3-VL-8B模型生成对视觉证据的有决定条件的解释. 对于假图像,第二个Qwen3-VL-8B在不使用图像的情况下将文本压缩成一个短的非专家摘要. 我们进一步采用 " 尺度一致的集团相对政策优化 " (GRPO),根据挑战标准优化两个解释者。 在相应的条件下,GRPO将复杂的BERTScore-F1从0.686提高到了0.712,并改进了地基定位(实体和证据F1);我们的呈件在复杂的BERTScore-F1和总体上排名第七。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en:
The realism of synthetic imagery has advanced to the point where it is nearly
indistinguishable from authentic content. This is particularly evident for
deepfake imagery, whose low-cost creation is routinely misused for harmful
ends, including misinformation and deliberate attacks on individuals’
reputations. Moving beyond straightforward identity replacement, modern
generative pipelines enable nuanced person-centric edits that modify
actions, object interactions, and overall scene semantics while preserving the
subject’s identity ( Gupta et al., 2025 ) . As generation methods
advance, detectors still struggle to generalize beyond the generators and
manipulation methods seen during training ( Guillaro et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2025 ) ,
making reliable identification of manipulated content increasingly demanding.

blocks.en:
Despite this growing sophistication of synthetic content, deepfake detection
systems are typically evaluated on classification accuracy alone: a detector
need only output a binary real/fake label, without articulating which regions,
objects, or attributes support that decision. This leaves a critical gap for
real-world deployment, where both experts and non-expert users need to understand how an image was manipulated and which specific changes alter the style,
semantics, or narrative of the scene, especially for localized edits to
actions, interactions, or context, not merely whether it was flagged
as synthetic.

blocks.en:
The Deepfake Explainability Challenge ( Narang et al., 2026b ) introduces a new paradigm in which detectors must identify manipulations
and generate grounded natural-language explanations.
blocks.zh:
" Deepfake Explainable Challenge " (Narang等人,2026年b)引入了探测器必须识别操纵行为的新范式.
并生成基于自然语言的解释。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we present our solution to this challenge: a decoupled
predict-then-explain pipeline that separates foundation-model detection from
decision-conditioned explanation generation. This design provides the
explainer with a predetermined authenticity decision, rather than relying on
the autoregressive output to generate a class-specific narrative before
deciding. Because token-level supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is
only indirectly aligned with the sequence-level metrics used for evaluation,
we follow the recent reinforcement-learning post-training
trend ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025 ) and further optimize
explanations with GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) against the challenge’s
semantic-similarity metrics. Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We introduce a decoupled predict-then-explain pipeline for explainable
deepfake detection. • The method tackles decision bias and related errors in combined
decision and explanation generation. • We apply metric-aligned GRPO post-training for both complex and
simple explanations, improving over SFT alone.

blocks.en: 2. Related work
blocks.zh: 2. 国家 相关工作

blocks.en:
The detection of AI-generated images has shifted from specialized forensic
systems to vision foundation models
(VFMs) ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) . Frozen DINOv3 and
SigLIP2 features with lightweight heads perform strongly on generated-image
and in-the-wild benchmarks ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) , while
LoRA adaptation, forensic heads, and complementary VFM ensembles further
improve robustness ( Yu et al., 2026 ; Bombek1, 2025 ; Gushchin et al., 2026 ) .
These methods achieve strong real-versus-fake classification, but they do not
generally explain the visual evidence behind their decisions.

(Yu等人,2026年;Bombek1,2025年;Gushchin等人,2026年)
这些方法实现了强烈的真假分类,但并没有
一般地解释他们决定背后的视觉证据。

blocks.en:
Recent forensic vision-language models add textual explanations. M2F2-Det
couples a forgery encoder with an LLM so detection features inform both the
fake probability and its explanation ( Guo et al., 2025 ) . VIGIL structures
forensic reasoning as a plan-then-examine process over facial
evidence ( Li et al., 2026 ) . IFDL-VLM ( Guo et al., 2026 ) decouples detection and localization from
explanation and conditions the VLM on mask-enhanced visual features; we
condition it on binary detector decisions instead. This predict-then-explain
ordering is also more data-efficient than explain-then-predict
training ( Jang and Lukasiewicz, 2021 ) .

blocks.en:
GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) extends the RL post-training line of
RLHF ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) and DeepSeek-R1 ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025 ) by
comparing group-sampled completions without a value model. VIGIL uses
part-aware GRPO for facial forensics ( Li et al., 2026 ) ; we apply metric-aligned
GRPO to the challenge’s BERTScore-F1 and SLE rewards.

actions, interactions, and scene context while preserving
identity ( Gupta et al., 2025 ) . Building on this, XPlainVerse

detection ( Narang et al., 2026a ; Narang et al., 2026b ) .

blocks.en: 3. Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1. Overview

Detection and explanation are handled separately in our pipeline
(Figure 1 ). Given an input image, a vision-foundation model
(VFM) detector first predicts whether the image is real or fake. The image and
this predetermined decision are then passed to a vision-language model (VLM),
which produces a detailed complex explanation of the visible evidence.
For fake images, a second Qwen3-VL-8B summarizes the complex text into a brief
non-expert explanation without using the image. The subsequent subsections
explain the detector, the complex explainer, and the simple explainer.
blocks.zh:
侦测和解释由我们单独处理
(图1). 在输入图像的情况下,建立视觉模型
(VFM)探测器首先预测图像是真实的还是假的. 图像和
这一预先确定的决定随后转而采用视觉语言模式,
对可见的证据作了详细的复杂解释。
对于假图像,第二个 Quen3-VL-8B 将复杂的文本归纳为简短
不使用图像的非专家解释。 其后各小节
解释探测器、复杂的解释器和简单的解释器。

blocks.en: 3.2. Detection

We employ a Bombek1-style dual-encoder
classifier ( Bombek1, 2025 ) . In the first branch, features from
Global SigLIP2-SO400M and DINOv2-Large are concatenated and passed to an MLP
binary classifier. The second branch follows the DINO-MAC architecture used
in the NTIRE 2026 winning solution ( Gushchin et al., 2026 ) : for each of the final
four DINOv3-Large blocks, mean-pooled patch features are concatenated with
the classification token and four register tokens, then passed to a
layer-specific binary head. All four heads are supervised during training;
during inference, only the final-layer logit is used. In both branches, the
pretrained backbone weights remain frozen; only LoRA adapters in the
attention layers and the binary classification heads are trained. Logits
from each branch are combined using a weight selected on held-out data,
converted into a pseudo-probability, and compared to a threshold to produce
the final real/fake decision. The detector provides only this decision
label; all text generation occurs further down the pipeline.

分类器 (Bombek1, 2025 ). 第一个分支的特征来自

层特定二进制头。 所有4名负责人在培训期间都接受监督;

最后真实/虚假的决定。 探测器只提供这个决定
标签; 所有文本生成在管道下进一步发生。

blocks.en: 3.3. Complex Explanation Generation
blocks.zh: 3.3. 复杂解释生成

blocks.en:
The complex explanation is generated by Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. During inference, the
image is paired with one of two decision-conditioned prompts. The hypothetical-fake prompt requests visible inconsistencies or synthesis
artifacts, whereas the hypothetical-real prompt requests concrete cues
that support authenticity. Both request an evidence-focused paragraph followed by a Verdict: real/fake line, used to reward label consistency during training and stripped before submission. The VLM is adapted via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with low-rank
adapters on one primary and two hypothetical prompt forms
(Section 4.3 ), then
refined with metric-aligned GRPO (Section 4.5 ). As a joint baseline, we also train
the same Qwen3-VL-8B with the primary prompt alone so the VLM both decides
and explains; its failure modes motivate the decoupled pipeline
(Section 5 ).

复杂的解释由Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct生成. 在推论期间,
图像与两个具有决定条件的提示之一对齐。 假想- 假冒的提示请求可见的不一致或合成
艺术品,而假想的 - 真实的迅速要求 混凝土提示
这证明了真实性。 两者都要求以证据为重点的段落,然后是判决:真实/假线,用于奖励培训期间的标签一致性,并在提交之前剥离。 VLM通过有监督的微调(SFT)进行低级调整
在一个初级表格和两个假设快速表格上的适配器
(第4.3节),然后

相同的Qwen3 -VL -8B 单是主提示,所以VLM都决定
并解释;其故障模式促使管道脱钩
(第5节)

blocks.en: 3.4. Simple Explanation Generation
blocks.zh: 3.4. 简单解释生成

blocks.en:
For fake images, a second Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct model turns the complex
explanation into a short summary in everyday language. This simple explainer
is trained on text-only paired complex and simple references with the same
SFT-then-GRPO recipe, using the competition’s simple-explanation metric as the
reward (Section 4.5 ). For real images, the complex
explanation is submitted to both output fields, as required by the benchmark.

blocks.en: 4.2. Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: 4.2. 评价议定书

blocks.en:
Labels are binary: 0 indicates a real image, while 1 indicates a generated or
manipulated image. Macro F1 is calculated across both classes using all
200,000 test images.
blocks.zh:
标签为二进制: 0 表示真实图像, 1 表示生成或
被操纵的图像 。 宏 F1在两个类别均采用所有方法计算。
20万测试影像.

blocks.en:
Each prediction requires a detailed complex explanation and a concise simple
explanation, both consistent with the submitted label. Complex explanations
are scored with BERTScore-F1. Simple explanations combine BERTScore-F1 (70%)
with an SLE simplicity score (30%), after clipping SLE to [ − 1 , 4 ] [-1,4] and
mapping it to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ; we refer to this weighted sum as the simple overall
score. During the competition, the reported reference explanation score was
the average of complex BERTScore-F1 and simple overall.
blocks.zh:
每项预测都需要详细的复杂解释和简明扼要
说明,两者均符合提交的标签。 复杂解释
以BERTScore-F1计分。 简单的解释结合了BERTScore-F1(70%)
在将 SLE 剪辑为 [− 1, 4] [-1, 4] 之后,
将其映射为[0, 1] [0, 1];我们把这一加权总和称为简单的整体
分数。 比赛期间,报告的参考解释分数是
复杂BERTScore-F1和简单整体的平均值。

blocks.en:
The grounding score was omitted during the competition because of its
computational cost. In the post-competition evaluation, a fixed Qwen3.5-4B
judge extracts diagnostic entities and evidence claims from generated and
reference complex explanations. The same judge then measures semantic
coverage in both directions by deciding, for each entity and claim, whether
it is present in the other explanation based on meaning rather than exact
wording. The two directional scores are then combined by their harmonic mean
to produce entity F1 and evidence F1, which are averaged to obtain the

overall score is the mean of this explanation score and detection macro F1.

blocks.en: 4.3. Supervised Training Corpus and Prompt Design
blocks.zh: 4.3. 监督培训公司和快速设计

blocks.en:
We build the explanation corpus from official train and validation
annotations; only the train set is used for training. Each complex sample pairs an image with a
user prompt; the target is the reference text plus Verdict: real/fake . For the simple tier, each fake complex reference
is paired with its simple summary under a text-only compression prompt.
Complex training uses three templates mixed at about 50%/25%/25%: the primary template asks the model to decide authenticity and justify it
from visible evidence, while hypothetical-fake and hypothetical-real provide the ground-truth decision and ask only for
supporting explanation. At inference we use only the hypothetical template
matching the detector prediction, so the explainer does not classify the
image. All templates request multi-region evidence to match reference style
and grounding criteria; the fake-conditioned form asks for structured
technical analysis, and the real-conditioned form uses less technical
language for the typically shorter real references. We keep fake references
with at least three sentences and 80 words and train at a 4:1 fake-to-real
ratio.

blocks.en: 5. Results
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结果

blocks.en:
Our primary-prompt VLM baseline showed a strong real bias: on 2,000
validation images held out from explanation-model training, 65% of explanations used a generic real-style opening and
the fake false-negative rate was 44.8 % 44.8\% . This behavior is consistent with the
semantic-plausibility bias observed in forensic VLMs, which tend to prioritize
coherent scene semantics and surface realism over subtle authenticity
cues ( Guo et al., 2026 ; Tariq et al., 2025 ) . The same model is also a weaker
detector than the vision ensemble ( 0.772 0.772 vs. 0.972 0.972 macro F1 on a separate
1,000-image holdout). We therefore let the ensemble decide and ask the VLM
only to explain. Giving the explainer the correct label on those 2,000 images
raised complex BERTScore-F1 from 0.698 0.698 to 0.733 0.733 .

cues(Guo等人,2026年;Tariq等人,2025年). 同样的模型也是弱者

blocks.en:
To evaluate GRPO’s impact, we ran an additional controlled experiment that
directly compared SFT and GRPO complex explanations on the same 10,000
explanation-scored test images. Both models received identical images,
detector decisions, decision-conditioned prompts, and decoding settings; only
the explainer adapter differed.
As shown in Table 3 , GRPO raises complex BERTScore-F1 by 0.026 0.026 and also improves entity F1, evidence F1, and grounding, even
though entity and evidence coverage were never online rewards. Together,
these results indicate that GRPO improves not only complex BERTScore-F1, but
also coverage of the diagnostic entities and evidence claims identified in
the references.

blocks.en: 6. Discussion
blocks.zh: 6个 讨论情况

blocks.en:
The final leaderboard highlights complex BERTScore-F1 as our strongest component,
ranking first among all submissions. GRPO improved both complex BERTScore-F1 and
the grounding score. Although it used a quick, cost-effective BERTScore-F1
reward instead of entity F1 and evidence F1, its outputs covered more of the
diagnostic entities and evidence claims seen in the references.
Two main limitations remain. First, the reference simple explanations already
favor short motifs such as “sticker” and “doll,” and metric-aligned GRPO
overuses these patterns in even shorter, more repetitive responses. As a
result, the official simple score rises, mainly via SLE, while linguistic
diversity falls. Second, the predict-then-explain approach propagates detector
errors: while conditioning maintains decision consistency, an incorrect
decision leads the explainer to produce evidence supporting the wrong class.
blocks.zh:
最后的领导板强调复杂的BERTScore-F1 是我们最强的部分,
在所有划界案中排名第一。 GPRO改进了复杂的BERTScore-F1和
落地分数。 虽然它使用了快速、成本效益高的BERTScore-F1
奖励而不是实体F1和证据F1,其产出涵盖更多
诊断实体和证据索赔见参考文献。
仍然存在两个主要限制。 首先,简单的参考解释已经
偏好“粘贴剂”和“娃娃”等短的基点,以及量度一致的GRPO
在更短、更重复的反应中,过度使用这些模式。 作为一名
结果,官方的简单分数上升,主要通过SLE,而语言
多样性下降。 第二,预测和解释方法传播探测器
错误: 调制保持决定一致性时, 不正确
裁决导致解释者提出支持错误类别的证据。

blocks.en: 7. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7. 结论

blocks.en:
These results highlight the value of separating detection from explanation:
specialized vision models determine authenticity, while language models
communicate the supporting evidence for that fixed decision. Metric-aligned
reinforcement learning with GRPO can then improve those explanations using
inexpensive rewards. Because each image has only one reference explanation,
grounding can under-credit plausible alternative evidence; closing this gap
will require grounding-aware judges that are fast enough for online training,
so that GRPO can reward evidence supported by the image rather than BERTScore-F1
alone. Developing such judges, richer reward signals, and comparisons with other
sequence-level methods remains an important direction for future research.
blocks.zh:
这些结果突出了将检测与解释区分开来的价值:
专业视觉模型确定真实性,而语言模型
提供该固定决定的佐证证据。 量子对齐
利用GRPO进行强化学习,然后可以使用
便宜的奖励。 因为每个图像只有一个参考解释
建立基础可以低估可信的替代证据;缩小这一差距
需要具备基本认识的法官 足够快速的在线培训,
这样,GPRO就可以奖励由图像而不是BERTScore-F1支持的证据.
一个人 发展这种法官、丰富的奖励信号以及与其他法官的比较
序列级方法仍然是未来研究的一个重要方向。
